density_definition.active_vehicle: Unique approved ByteTrack track_id present in a frame, belonging to one of: car, bus, truck, motorcycle. Each track_id counted at most once per frame.
density_definition.normalization_constant_meaning: Peak active vehicle count across all processed frames. Makes the score range [0.0, 1.0] within the processing window.
density_definition.units: dimensionless (relative occupancy ratio) — NOT vehicles/km or vehicles/km^2
density_definition.physical_calibration: UNAVAILABLE — no lane width, road area, or GPS calibration
density_definition.class_assignment: Direct YOLOv8n+ByteTrack label per frame — no smoothing or majority-vote correction

performance.note: Density computation runs on Stage 3 frame_log (no re-inference). Total pipeline time = Stage 3 inference time + this computation time.
